question: what is the percentage change in the the outstanding debt under the 3.00% ( 3.00 % ) notes from 2007 to 2008?
reasoning: We need percentage change in outstanding debt under 3.00% notes from 2007 to 2008. From document: In Long-Term Obligations schedule: 3.00% convertible notes: 2008: $161,893 (in thousands), 2007: $344,568. Also note text says as of Dec 31, 2008 and 2007, outstanding debt under 3.00% Notes was $161.9 million (principal $162.2 million) and $344.6 million. Use 161,893 and 344,568. Percentage change = (2008-2007)/2007 *100 = (161893-344568)/344568 = -182675/344568 ≈ -0.5302 = -53.02%. So answer -53.0% or -53.02%. Need provide evidence and program. Use figures as printed: 161,893 and 344,568. Program: multiply(divide(subtract(161893, 344568), 344568), 100).
raw_content:
<evidence>
161,893 | Long-term obligations schedule: 3.00% convertible notes 2008
344,568 | Long-term obligations schedule: 3.00% convertible notes 2007
</evidence>
<program>
multiply(divide(subtract(161893, 344568), 344568), 100)
</program>
<answer>-53.02%</answer>
